_note: Group-1 DEV set (draft). Prompts/parsers may be tuned on these tasks. The FROZEN test set is written separately by Nov 23 and is never tuned against.

tasks.text: Characterize an NMOS SKY130 1.8 V NFET with W = 1 um and L = 180 nm at room temperature. Generate an Id-Vg curve with VDS fixed at 1.8 V, sweeping VGS from 0 to 1.8 V in steps of 0.02 V. Measure threshold voltage, transconductance, subthreshold swing, on-current at 1.8 V and off-current at 0 V. Use a maximum of 200 simulation points.

NMOS, SKY130 NFET, width 2000 nm, length 0.15 um, temperature 85 °C. Transfer curve: VDS fixed at 0.9 V, sweep gate voltage from 0 to 1.2 V with 49 points. Measure Vth, SS, Ion at 1.2 V and Ioff at 0 V. Max 100 simulation points.

Run an Id-Vd output characteristic of an NMOS (SKY130 NFET), W = 5 um, L = 0.5 um, at 125 degrees C. Hold VGS at 1.2 V and sweep VDS from 0 to 1.8 V in 0.05 V steps. I need the output conductance and the drain current curve. Budget of 60 simulation points.
Characterize an NMOS SKY130 NFET with L = 180 nm at 27 °C. Id-Vg with VDS fixed at 1.8 V, VGS from 0 to 1.8 V in steps of 0.02 V. Measure threshold voltage. Use a maximum of 200 simulation points.
Characterize an NMOS SKY130 NFET with W = 1 um and L = 0.18 um. Id-Vg with VDS fixed at 1.8 V, VGS from 0 to 1.8 V in steps of 0.02 V. Measure threshold voltage. Maximum of 200 simulation points.

NMOS SKY130 NFET, W = 1 um, L = 0.18 um, room temperature. Id-Vg curve with VDS fixed at 1.8 V and VGS fixed at 0.9 V, sweeping VGS from 0 to 1.8 V in steps of 0.02 V. Measure threshold voltage. Maximum of 200 simulation points.
NMOS SKY130 NFET, W = 1 um, L = 0.18 um, at 27 °C. Id-Vg curve, VDS fixed at 1.8 V, VGS from 0 to 1.8 V in steps of 0.02 V. Measure the output conductance. Maximum of 200 simulation points.
NMOS SKY130 NFET, W = 1 um, L = 0.18 um, at 27 °C. Id-Vg curve, VDS fixed at 1.8 V, VGS from 0 to 1.8 V in steps of 0.02 V. Measure the on-current. Maximum of 200 simulation points.
NMOS SKY130 NFET, W = 1 um, L = 0.18 um, at 27 °C. Id-Vg curve, VDS fixed at 1.8 V, VGS from 0 to 1.8 V in steps of 0.02 V. Measure the threshold voltage.
NMOS SKY130 NFET, W = 1 um, L = 0.18 um, at 27 °C. Id-Vg curve, VDS fixed at 1.8 V, VGS from 0 to 1.8 V in steps of 0.07 V. Measure the threshold voltage. Maximum of 200 simulation points.

Hi team. Our lab has 40 engineers, the board supply is nominally 3.3 V and the package is 3 mm wide, but none of that matters here. Please characterize an NMOS SKY130 NFET: W = 1 um, L = 0.18 um, at room temperature. Id-Vg, VDS fixed at 1.8 V, VGS from 0 to 1.8 V in steps of 0.02 V. Measure the threshold voltage only. Maximum of 120 simulation points.

NMOS SKY130 NFET, W = 420 nm, L = 150 nm, temperature -40 °C. Id-Vg, VDS fixed at 1.8 V, sweep VGS from 0 to 1.8 V in steps of 20 mV. Measure subthreshold swing and off-current at 0 V. Maximum of 100 simulation points.
Please characterize a transistor for me and tell me how good it is.
